title: V5: remove orphan cluster timing params + seal interval drift correction
brief: Remove consensus-timing CLI/config fields that are overwritten or unused (tx_catchup_ms, cluster-attest-timeout-ms). Add genesis-nominal seal cadence with wall-clock drift correction every 100 sealed blocks (max ±1% interval adjust per step, INFO log).

remove_entirely: cluster_timing_ms catchup leg if unused — keep attest derivation only
--cluster-attest-timeout-ms CLI when cluster.enabled (always derive via apply_cluster_timing)
keep_derived_internal_only: cluster_cfg.attest_timeout_ms — set only by apply_cluster_timing from seal_ms; not operator-tunable
do_not_remove: transport heartbeat/timeout CLI (ops; proposer cap stays in apply_cluster_timing)
orphan_removal.rfc16_note: T_tx_catchup (RFC16 §6.1) not implemented in pwmd yet — do not reintroduce dead config; future slice wires attester catch-up using derived constant from seal_ms in code, not CLI.

drift_correction.trigger: On successful local seal, when tip_h - window_start_h >= 100
drift_correction.measurement: wall_clock elapsed for last 100 sealed blocks (Instant at window start → now)
drift_correction.adjustment_cap: ±1% of current effective_interval_ms per correction step (not unbounded PID)
drift_correction.direction: If actual > expected (slow), decrease effective interval; if actual < expected (fast), increase
drift_correction.apply: Use effective_interval_ms for next sleep/tick (replace or reset tokio::interval after adjust)
drift_correction.logging: INFO each adjustment: e.g. seal_cadence_drift blocks=100 nominal_ms=… effective_ms=… actual_ms=… expected_ms=… adjust_pct=…
drift_correction.scope: Active local sealer only (single-sealer proposer); skip attester/follower/debug-disable-seal-loop
drift_correction.constants: Name magic 500 in cluster_timing_ms if retained — prefer seal_ms/2 or single CLUSTER_ATTEST_JITTER_MS with comment tied to nominal seal

explicit_non_goals: No --seal-interval-ms or operator override of cadence
No full RFC16 §6.1 attester tx catch-up implementation in this ticket
Drift correction is local scheduler only — not a consensus fork parameter

acceptance_criteria: grep/code: no tx_catchup_ms in ClusterCfg, main CLI, or startup logs.
grep/code: no --cluster-attest-timeout-ms / --cluster-tx-catchup-ms in main.rs (cluster mode derives timing only).
apply_cluster_timing still sets attest_timeout_ms from genesis seal_ms; cluster proposer heartbeat cap unchanged.
spawn_seal_loop: drift state; every 100 successful seals adjusts effective sleep within ±1%; logs adjustment.
Unit tests: seal_interval_ms; drift adjust math (slow/fast, clamp 1%); orphan field removal compiles.
cargo test -p pwmd --lib lifecycle; cargo check -p pwmd -p pwm-core.
docs/runbooks/v5-cy-cluster-precloseout-soak.md: document seal_cadence_drift log and nominal vs effective interval.
config/tests updated for removed cluster CLI fields.
notes: Owner: purge orphaned params; drift-correct effective sealing interval toward genesis blocks_per_hour target. Owner clarification 2026-05-31 (see 20260531-v5-seal-cadence-drift-oscillation-log-review): invariant is ±1% band around nominal_ms at all times, NOT only ±1% step on accumulated effective_ms — coding follow-up must clamp envelope if log review confirms gap.
